headline: A size‑up after loss is costing you.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The behavior cost you ₹1,05,732. It occurred in 96 trades where the median entry size after a loss was ₹12,562 compared with ₹6,578 otherwise, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of ₹1,95,375 and had a win rate of 28% versus 39% for other trades.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is worth watching as it may affect your results.

closing: Consider applying the rule about keeping your entry size after a loss for the next review period.
